_comment: Voice casting for The Iron Wake. Maps speaker names (as passed to _say_as / dialogue_box.show_dialogue) to ElevenLabs premade voice IDs. Premade voices work with a TTS-only key (no voices_read permission needed). Edit voice_ids to recast. This file contains NO secrets and is safe to commit.
_speaker_settings_comment: Optional per-speaker overrides merged over voice_settings (and in turn overridden by per-line picks in voice_overrides.json). Derived from Casting Studio picks (median of saved beach-room picks, 2026-07-09): ROWAN spoken = Daniel, low stability/expressive; ROWAN_VO = Antoni narration (a DELIBERATELY different actor from spoken ROWAN, confirmed 2026-07-09); PINDLE deadpan; TIBBIT expressive. Lower stability = more emotional variation, higher style = more expressive delivery.

_casting_notes.ROWAN: Daniel — British mature; recast from Antoni via Casting Studio picks (2026-07-09, 5/5). Rowan's spoken dialogue. DELIBERATELY a different voice from his narration (ROWAN_VO) — confirmed by Alex 2026-07-09, do not unify.
_casting_notes.ROWAN_VO: Antoni — Rowan's narration/voiceover voice. Intentionally a DIFFERENT actor from spoken ROWAN (Daniel): Daniel when talking to characters, Antoni for 'look at' narration. Confirmed split 2026-07-09.
_casting_notes.TIBBIT: Josh — brighter young male, enthusiastic tinkerer
_casting_notes.PINDLE: Adam — deep authoritative male, pompous bureaucrat
_casting_notes.CALIGO: Charlie — smooth accented, the velvet-voiced rival
